card.name: The end of interleukin
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, usually just before a hyphen and a number such as -1, -2 or -6. Rare weaker hits appear on word endings in other names or scripts.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The piece "in" that completes interleukin before a number or abbreviation.
modes.example: Concurrent administration of anakinra (an interleuk<<in>>-1 antagonist) and another TNF

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Scattered endings inside capitalized words, names or foreign script.
